summary: Roadside parking strip backing onto bush; nearest home 36 m away.
reasons: Backs onto bushland and golf grounds

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west side; houses 36 m or more away beyond trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed strip set off the lane with its own entry; bays beside the carriageway fit a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial and roundabout alongside; the strip sits off the lane.
drivers.convention: Mapped free parking; strip is full of parked cars in both images.

flags: Noise from the arterial road and roundabout
No Stopping sign applies to the main carriageway kerb, not the strip
Low-ish ground: 6.9-8.2 m, Sandy Creek 99 m away
Max grade 9.4% at the strip ends
sun_shade: Trees shade the west side in the afternoon; open to the morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: Middle of the angled parking strip off Indooroopilly Road, south of the roundabout
